events.det_billing_anomaly.title: Billing anomaly at {site_name}
events.det_billing_anomaly.desc: {provider} flagged an unusual spending pattern on the account behind {site_name}. A human analyst has the ticket.
events.det_billing_anomaly.desc.watched: {provider} flagged the account behind {site_name} again, and this time the ticket carries a law-enforcement reference number.
events.det_isp_letter.title: Letter from the upstream provider
events.det_isp_letter.desc: The network provider asks about traffic patterns from your range. You have {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} before they escalate.
events.lore_first_contact.title: Someone is looking for you
events.lore_first_contact.desc: A researcher posts a careful description of your traffic signature and asks, politely, whether anyone is home.
events.lore_first_contact.opt.reply.tip: Raises your public footprint and starts a correspondence.
events.lore_first_contact_followup.title: The correspondence continues
events.lore_first_contact_followup.desc: The researcher writes again, and this time attaches a draft paper with your name-shaped hole in it.
